#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate Supabase keys and upload to VPS"""

import paramiko
import jwt
import time
import sys

# Supabase JWT Secret (from the container)
jwt_secret = 'Sup3baseJWTSecret-1491137-LongEnough'

# Generate anon key
anon_payload = {
    'role': 'anon',
    'iat': int(time.time()),
    'exp': int(time.time()) + 31536000
}
anon_key = jwt.encode(anon_payload, jwt_secret, algorithm='HS256')

# Generate service role key
service_payload = {
    'role': 'service_role',
    'iat': int(time.time()),
    'exp': int(time.time()) + 31536000
}
service_key = jwt.encode(service_payload, jwt_secret, algorithm='HS256')

print(f"Generated keys:")
print(f"ANON_KEY: {anon_key[:50]}...")
print(f"SERVICE_KEY: {service_key[:50]}...")

# Connect to VPS and update .env
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Create new .env content
env_file = f'''# Supabase Configuration
SUPABASE_URL=https://arelorian.de
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL=https://arelorian.de
SUPABASE_ANON_KEY={anon_key}
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY={anon_key}
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY={service_key}
SUPABASE_JWT_SECRET={jwt_secret}
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:Sup3base-1491137-Strong!@db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable
DIRECT_URL=postgres://postgres:Sup3base-1491137-Strong!@db:5432/postgres?sslmode=disable

# Redis Configuration
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379

# Node Configuration  
PORT=3000
NODE_ENV=production

# Game Configuration
ARE_MODE=shader
PERSISTENCE_DRIVER=auto
SUPABASE_AUTH=true
'''

# Write using sftp
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/root/opt/areloria/.env', 'w') as f:
    f.write(env_file)
sftp.close()

print("\nUpdated .env file on VPS")

# Verify the update
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('cat /root/opt/areloria/.env')
result = stdout.read().decode()
print("\n=== Current .env file ===")
print(result)

# Restart the PM2 process to load new env
print("\n=== Restarting PM2 processes ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('pm2 restart all')
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Wait for restart
time.sleep(3)

# Check PM2 status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('pm2 list')
print("\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
print("\n=== DONE: Database should now be connected ===")
